class Invader : Actor() {
    init {
        val sprite = Image()
        sprite.scale(32, 22)
        sprite.setColor(104, 220, 130)
        sprite.fillRect(4, 2, 24, 16)
        sprite.setColor(17, 24, 39)
        sprite.fillRect(9, 7, 4, 4)
        sprite.fillRect(19, 7, 4, 4)
        sprite.setColor(104, 220, 130)
        sprite.fillRect(0, 18, 8, 4)
        sprite.fillRect(24, 18, 8, 4)
        setImage(sprite)
    }
}
